chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve')
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you')
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard')
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
itiohil: itiojil — your flesh; i- 'your (pl.)' + tiojil 'flesh, meat'
xꜭhauic: xch'awik — it spoke; x- completive + ch'aw 'speak' + -ik
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us')
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads')
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik
nau: naw — think, understand; verb, root of na'oj 'mind' (xe naw 'they thought')
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
xcut: xkut — was struck (guess, uncertain); perhaps 'showed', root of k'utun
xot: xot — griddle, the clay comal for tortillas; noun
xꜭhau: xch'aw — it spoke; x- completive + ch'aw 'speak'
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun
xca: xqa — we (did it); x- completive + qa- 'we', subject of a transitive verb
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
xcute: xkute — doubtful reading (MS xcuhe); taken as a verb, perhaps that of xkut 'struck'; sense uncertain
xban: xb'an — it was done; x- completive + b'an 'do, make' passive
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state
ꜯac: tz'aq — built, construction; root tz'aq 'build' (a wall); as in qatz'aq 'our built'
bit: b'it — shape, mould (as clay); root of B'itol, here in winaq b'it 'a shaped person'
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb
quechelah: k'echelaj — forest; a second spelling of quichelah (k'iche'laj): k'iche' 'many trees' + -laj
xꜭohe: xk'oje — it was, came to be; x- completive + k'oje 'be, exist'
ahꜯac: Ajtz'aq — He-who-builds; aj- 'one who' + tz'aq 'build'; title of a creator
ahbit: Ajb'it — He-who-shapes; aj- 'one who' + b'it 'shape'; title of a creator
vachinic: wachinik — bearing fruit, taking shape; wachin 'bear fruit, show itself' (from wach 'face, fruit') + -ik
aham: ajam — carved; perfect participle of aj 'carve' (ajam che' 'carved wood')
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
mahabi: majab'i — there is not, not yet; negative particle
ꜫih: q'ij — day, sun; noun (Ratit Q'ij 'Grandmother of the Day'); in ki q'ij 'their day' perhaps 'their lot, fortune' (uncertain)
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun
naual: nawal — spirit power, spirit-double; shared with Nahuatl nahualli (Spanish nagual)
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
zaquil: saqil — whiteness, light, clarity; saq 'white' + -il abstract noun
raxa: raxa — green-blue, fresh; adjective in names (Raxa Kaqulja)
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
al: al — child (of a mother); noun, paired with k'ajol 'son'
ꜭahol: k'ajol — son, child (of a man); noun
vxic: uxik — becoming, coming to be; ux 'become' + -ik (xe uxik 'they came to be')
mana: mana — not; negative, a form of ma
cutun: k'utun — appear, be shown; verb root, as in uk'utunisaxik 'its being shown'
xbanic: xb'anik — it was made; x- completive + b'an 'make' + passive -ik
butic: b'utik — flood, flooding; noun, also 'be flooded'
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki-
